examples.notebooks: One complete executed standalone notebook per new page, generated from canonical Markdown

conventions: Beginning-of-period weights; no look-ahead use of returns or bond prices
Arithmetic expected return for mean-variance inputs, with consistent horizon for covariance and risk-free rate
Efficient frontier is the upper nondominated branch; distinguish CAL and equilibrium CML
SLSQP convergence and constraints checked; optimization cannot remove parameter uncertainty
Historical rolling correlation is descriptive and pairwise self-correlation is excluded
CPPI clips risky weights to [0,1]; fixed floor and drawdown floor are separate; discrete gaps can breach both
Exact exponential GBM is distinguished from Normal-gross-return approximations
Monte Carlo sampling uncertainty is separate from model error; zero observed breaches is not a guarantee
Annual-effective yield is separate from continuously compounded short rates
PV and duration matching is local, depends on curve moves and does not insure against default or basis risk
CIR scenario probabilities and risk-neutral pricing use explicitly distinguished measures
Coupon and redemption cash flows are counted once in total returns
Goal-based floors use beginning-of-period discount-bond prices; conditional and unconditional deficits are reported separately
